page.overview:
Who is Citipati?

(meaning "funeral pyre lord") is an extinct genus of oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived in Mongolia during the Late Cretaceous period.

Citipati is mentioned in Jurassic World: The Game in the 2nd evolution trivia of the Oviraptor. The fact tells that there are sparse fossils of the Oviraptor, so a reconstruction of it is heavily based on the Citipati.
